in_arabic.name: مرشدة
in_arabic.meaning: المرشدة تعني من يهدي و يرشد الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مرشدة مشتق من كلمة 'رشاد' و تعني الهداية و الرشاد. في اللغة العربية، يُطلق على الشخص الذي يهدي الناس و يرشدهم إلى الطريق الصحيح. و في القرآن الكريم، نجد جذر الكلمة في سورة الحجر آية ٧٨ 'وَأَرسَلنَا رُشُلًا فَمِنهُم مَّن أَنجَينا وَمِنهُم مَّن ضَيَّعنَ' حيث جاءت كلمة 'رُشُل' بمعنى الرسل الذين يرشدون الناس.

in_urdu.name: مرشدہ
in_urdu.meaning: مرشدہ کا مطلب ہے جو لوگوں کی رہنمائی کرتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرشدہ نام عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'رشاد' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رہنمائی یا ہدایت کرنا۔ اس نام کا تعلق اس شخصیت سے ہے جو لوگوں کو صحیح راستے پر چلنے کے لئے رہنمائی کرتی ہے۔ اردو زبان میں، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اہم معانی رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر رہبری اور ہدایت کے معانی سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुरशिदा
in_hindi.meaning: मुरशिदा का अर्थ है जो लोगों को सही रास्ते पर ले जाती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुरशिदा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका संबंध 'रशाद' शब्द से है जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन या निर्देशन। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है जो दूसरों को सही मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करती है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: مرشده
in_pashto.meaning: مرشده دى هغه کسانو ته لارښودي کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د مرشده نوم په عربي ژبه کې د 'رشاد' د کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د لارښودنې او هدایت معنی لري. دا نوم داسې یو چا ته اشاره کوي چې نورو ته د سمې لارې موندنې کې مرسته کوي. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې، دا نوم د پام وړ مذهبي او کلتوري ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Murshidat
in_english.meaning: Murshidat means a guide or leader who shows the right path
in_english.long_meaning: The name Murshidat originates from the Arabic root 'r-sh-d', which means to guide or lead to the right path. In Islamic tradition, the term 'Murshid' refers to a spiritual guide or mentor. The name Murshidat signifies a person, often a woman, who guides others towards righteousness and moral integrity. It is a name that reflects leadership, wisdom, and spiritual guidance. Historically, the concept of a Murshid or spiritual guide is significant in Sufism and Islamic mysticism, where a Murshid provides spiritual direction to seekers on the path to enlightenment.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic tradition, the term "Murshidat" refers to a spiritual master or guide for seekers of truth and knowledge. Murshidat are often local religious leaders, scholars, or Sufi masters who inspire, teach, and provide guidance to their students and followers. Their role is in sharing the wisdom, moral values, and spiritual practices that enable individuals to live a pious life and attain inner peace and tranquility.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the term "Murshidat" can be traced back to the Islamic belief that every seeker of knowledge and truth needs a guide to navigate through the complexities of life. A Murshidat provides wisdom, insight, and understanding to those seeking guidance. This spiritual guide's role is crucial as they provide a bridge between the seeker and God, assisting individuals in their spiritual growth and development. Additionally, the relationship between Murshidat and their students is one of trust, respect, and unconditional love, creating strong bonds that endure throughout the student's journey towards self-improvement and personal enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide" symbolizes One who guides others to the right path. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Murshidat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Murshidat is mentioned in the book 'Kitab al-Aghani' as a female given name. The name Murshidat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name is mentioned in the context of the nobility and aristocracy of the time.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Murshidat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Fatima Murshidat in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Murshidat, which means "Guide". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
